name: Egyptian-Inspired Breakfast Beans with Tomato, Tahini & Warm Pita
instructions: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans in a colander.

When the onion is soft, add beans and tomatoes to the pot. Stir to combine and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer until the sauce has thickened and beans are tender, about 10 minutes.

While the beans are cooking, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the pot with the beans and stir to combine (reserve the remaining for serving).
Cut pita breads into wedges and arrange on a large baking sheet pan. When the beans are almost done, place pita bread in the oven and bake until warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the beans are done, wash, dry, and juice lemon into the pot. Add tahini, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Divide beans between plates or bowls and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Serve with pita on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
